videos.title: The Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron!
videos.hook: This planet literally rains boiling metal at night.
videos.fact: On WASP-76b, extreme day heat vaporizes iron. Winds blow it to the freezing night side. Unlike Earth's water rain, this vapor condenses into liquid iron droplets.

videos.title: The Star Colder Than Ice 🥶
videos.hook: There is a star you can touch without getting burned.
videos.fact: Meet WISE 0855, a failed star. Instead of blazing nuclear fire, this cosmic anomaly is actually freezing. Its temperature is way below zero, meaning its atmosphere is filled with water-ice clouds instead of burning gas.

videos.title: Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet 🤯
videos.hook: Why does your head age faster than your feet?
videos.fact: Gravity actually warps time. Because your feet are closer to Earth's center, gravity pulls harder on them. This slows down time at your feet, while your head ticks slightly faster in the weaker gravity above.

videos.title: The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b 🌌
videos.hook: This planet is darker than coal, swallowing all light.
videos.fact: Meet TrES-2b. It absorbs ninety-nine percent of light, reflecting almost nothing. It is a pitch-black cosmic mystery.

videos.title: This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies! 💎
videos.fact: On HAT-P-7b, clouds of vaporized corundum condense. This creates a literal rain of liquid rubies and sapphires.

videos.title: Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories 🤯
videos.hook: Your brain can create memories that never happened.
videos.fact: Memory is reconstructive. When you remember an event, your brain rebuilds parts of it, which means details can sometimes change without you realizing it.

videos.title: Sharks Are Older Than WHAT?! 🦈
videos.hook: How did sharks exist before trees even existed?
videos.fact: Sharks have roamed our oceans for over four hundred million years. The first trees didn't appear until fifty million years later. They survived four mass extinctions.

videos.title: What If J1407b Replaced Saturn?
videos.hook: If J1407b replaced Saturn, our sky would look like this.
videos.fact: Its ring system spans ninety million kilometers. At Saturn's distance, these rings would appear one hundred times wider than a full moon, shining incredibly bright.

videos.title: What If You Visited the Sunscreen Planet? 🪐
videos.hook: What if you visited the sunscreen planet?
videos.fact: On Kepler-13b, extreme gravity traps titanium oxide high in the atmosphere, creating heavy, dark snowstorms of actual sunscreen pigment.

videos.title: The Planet Where It Rains Rock! 🌧️🪨
videos.hook: Imagine a sky where it literally rains solid rocks.
videos.fact: On exoplanet CoRoT-7b, scorching temperatures vaporize solid rock into the atmosphere. This vaporized stone condenses into mineral clouds, unleashing a relentless downpour of liquid lava back to the surface.

videos.title: How Do Clouds Float If They Weigh THIS Much?
videos.hook: How does a million-pound object float right above you?
videos.fact: That fluffy white cloud is actually heavier than one hundred elephants. It only stays up because its water droplets are microscopic and spread across miles, resting on warm rising air.

videos.title: The Planet Where It Rains Liquid Metal! 🌧️🔥
videos.hook: Imagine a sky raining boiling, molten metal.
videos.fact: On exoplanet WASP-76b, extreme temperatures of forty-four hundred degrees vaporize iron. High-speed winds sweep this metal gas to the cooler night side...

videos.title: This Planet Is Being Eaten Alive! 😱
videos.hook: A pitch-black planet is being eaten alive.
videos.fact: This is WASP-12b. It absorbs almost all light, making it darker than asphalt. Its parent star is violently stripping its atmosphere away, heating the planet to over four thousand degrees.

videos.title: A Planet Where It May Rain Glass 😳
videos.hook: There is a planet where it may rain glass sideways.
videos.fact: On the exoplanet HD 189733 b, scientists have found evidence of extreme winds and silicate particles. Under those conditions, researchers think glass-like particles could be blown sideways.

videos.title: What If You Fell Into This $26 Nonillion Diamond Planet?
videos.hook: This planet is worth twenty-six nonillion dollars.
videos.fact: Meet fifty-five Cancri e, a super-Earth made of pressurized diamond. But if you fell here, you'd instantly vaporize. The temperature melts steel, creating vast, glowing oceans of liquid carbon.

videos.title: The Eyeball Planet That Could Harbor Life! 👁️
videos.hook: A giant eyeball is staring at us from deep space.
videos.fact: This is LHS 1140 b. Tidally locked, its dark side is frozen ice, while the star-facing side is a boiling ocean.
